prompt_en: Create a photorealistic documentary portrait of an adult polar radio-observatory maintenance engineer at an ice-rimed steerable dish during cobalt polar twilight. She calibrates a frost-coated low-noise receiver module with a handheld spectrum analyzer beside an open waveguide cabinet; tagged fiber lines, instrument readouts, snow fencing, and distant antenna structures establish the operational setting. Frame her chest-up in a restrained three-quarter view while her hands and analyzer remain legible. Hair is swept behind both ears, clear of the temples, cheek edges, jaw corners, and chin; the complete bilateral face perimeter remains unobscured. Give her a round compact face contour and a compact near-equal width-to-length silhouette: her facial length stays close to width, the cheek-to-cheek region carries broad width, and a soft curved jaw ends in a short rounded chin. A neutral expression and controlled perspective preserve the global contour. Use a distortion-controlled portrait lens and soft frontal shape light with cold ambient reflection from the snow. Realize the adult subject directly from this photographic specification.
